pitTutorial.fact1: If you earn less than ₦800,000/year, you pay ₦0 tax!
pitTutorial.fact2: Nigeria uses a progressive tax system - higher earners pay higher rates
pitTutorial.fact3: Your rent payments can reduce your taxable income!

pitTutorial.quizWrong: Actually, income below ₦800,000 is completely tax-free! Nigeria's tax law protects low-income earners.

vatcit.vatExplanation: VAT registration becomes mandatory once your annual turnover crosses ₦100M. TaxBridge tracks your turnover and helps you prepare in time.
vatcit.vatBullet1: Register once you exceed ₦100M in annual turnover
vatcit.vatBullet2: Charge 7.5% VAT on eligible goods and services
vatcit.vatBullet3: File VAT returns as required by FIRS
vatcit.vatQuizQuestion: When must you register for VAT?
vatcit.citFlowchartDesc: When does Company Income Tax apply?
vatcit.citBullet1: CIT applies to incorporated companies; PIT applies to sole proprietors
vatcit.citBullet2: CIT rate depends on annual turnover
vatcit.citBullet3: Keep records to support your filing and deductions
vatcit.citQuizQuestion: A company with ₦60M turnover pays what CIT rate?

taxBasics.title: Tax Essentials for You
taxBasics.subtitle: Key things you need to know based on your profile
taxBasics.soleProp1Desc: As a sole proprietor, you pay PIT on your business profits. Income below ₦800,000/year is tax-free!
taxBasics.soleProp2Desc: Keep receipts and invoices for at least 6 years. TaxBridge stores them safely offline.
taxBasics.soleProp3Desc: Register for VAT when turnover exceeds ₦100M. We'll track this for you.
taxBasics.registered1Desc: Registered companies pay CIT: 0% (≤₦50M), 20% (₦50-100M), or 30% (>₦100M) turnover.
taxBasics.registered2Desc: If VAT-registered, charge 7.5% on eligible goods/services and remit to FIRS.
taxBasics.registered3Desc: Use NRS-compliant invoices. TaxBridge generates them automatically!
taxBasics.default1Desc: Start by creating invoices to track your income and build compliance habits.
taxBasics.default2Desc: Income below ₦800,000/year is exempt from personal income tax.
taxBasics.default3Desc: Consider registering your business to unlock more tax benefits.
